result.summary: 本文训练了 1750 亿参数的自回归语言模型 GPT-3，并在不进行任何梯度更新或微调的情况下，测试其在零样本、单样本和少样本设置下的表现 [abstract][S1.p9]。GPT-3 在翻译、问答、完形填空以及需要即时推理或领域适应的任务上取得较强表现，有时接近此前最先进的微调方法 [abstract]。同时，论文也指出 GPT-3 在部分数据集上仍然表现不佳，并存在与大规模网络语料训练相关的方法学问题 [abstract]。作者还发现 GPT-3 生成的新闻文章样本让人类评估者难以与人类撰写的文章区分 [abstract]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：现有预训练加微调范式虽然架构与任务无关，但仍需要每个任务数千到数十万个特定任务的标注样本进行微调 [S1.p2]。作者认为去除这一限制是可取的，因为许多有用任务难以收集大规模监督训练数据，且人类通常只需简短指令或极少示例即可完成新语言任务 [S1.p3][S1.p5]。作者希望 NLP 系统也能具备这种灵活性和通用性 [S1.p5]。

evidence.quote: there is still a need for task-specific datasets and task-specific fine-tuning
Removing this limitation would be desirable, for several reasons.
the need for a large dataset of labeled examples for every new task limits the applicability of language models
humans do not require large supervised datasets to learn most language tasks
To be broadly useful, we would someday like our NLP systems to have this same fluidity and generality.

method.text: 论文训练了一个 1750 亿参数的自回归语言模型 GPT-3，其规模是此前任何非稀疏语言模型的 10 倍 [abstract]。模型沿用 GPT-2 的架构，但在 transformer 层中使用交替的稠密和局部带状稀疏注意力模式，并训练了从 1.25 亿到 1750 亿参数的 8 种不同规模模型 [S2.SS1.p1]。评估时 GPT-3 不进行任何梯度更新或微调，任务和少样本示例完全通过文本交互指定 [abstract]。具体评估三种条件：少样本（允许尽可能多的示例，通常 10 到 100 个）、单样本（仅一个示例）和零样本（仅自然语言指令）[S1.p9]。

evidence.quote: we train GPT-3, an autoregressive language model with 175 billion parameters, 10x more than any previous non-sparse language model
we use alternating dense and locally banded sparse attention patterns in the layers of the transformer
we train 8 different sizes of model, ranging over three orders of magnitude from 125 million parameters to 175 billion parameters
GPT-3 is applied without any gradient updates or fine-tuning, with tasks and few-shot demonstrations specified purely via text interaction with the model
we evaluate GPT-3 under 3 conditions: (a) “few-shot learning” ... (b) “one-shot learning” ... and (c) “zero-shot” learning

experiments.text: 论文在超过两打 NLP 数据集以及若干为测试快速适应能力而设计的新任务上评估 GPT-3 [S1.p9]。数据集被分为 9 个类别，涵盖语言建模、闭卷问答、翻译、Winograd 式任务、常识推理、阅读理解、SuperGLUE、NLI 以及合成与定性任务 [S3.p2][S3.p3]。少样本评估时从任务训练集中随机抽取 K 个示例作为条件，K 通常为 10 到 100，受模型上下文窗口 n_ctx=2048 限制 [S2.SS4.p1][S2.SS4.p2]。结果在公开测试集上报告，测试集私有时则报告开发集结果 [S2.SS4.p6]。

evidence.quote: we evaluate GPT-3 on over two dozen NLP datasets, as well as several novel tasks designed to test rapid adaptation
We group the datasets into 9 categories representing roughly similar tasks.
we evaluate each example in the evaluation set by randomly drawing $K$ examples from that task’s training set as conditioning
which is $n_{\mathrm{ctx}}=2048$ for all models and typically fits $10$ to $100$ examples
Final results are reported on the test set when publicly available, for each model size and learning setting

findings.text: GPT-3 在多个 NLP 数据集上取得较强表现，包括翻译、问答和完形填空，以及需要即时推理或领域适应的任务 [abstract]。在 LAMBADA 上，GPT-3 零样本达到 76%，比此前最先进结果提升 8%；少样本达到 86.4%，比此前最先进结果提升超过 18% [S3.SS1.SSS2.p1][S3.SS1.SSS2.p5]。在 TriviaQA 上，零样本 64.3%、单样本 68.0%、少样本 71.2%，其中零样本已超过微调的 T5-11B 14.2% [S3.SS2.p2]。在 CoQA 上，GPT-3 175B 少样本达到 85 F1，仅比人类基线和最先进微调模型低几个点 [S3.F7]。同时，GPT-3 在部分任务上仍然表现不佳，如 ANLI、RACE 或 QuAC [S1.p13]。在新闻文章生成上，人类识别模型生成文章的准确率从对照模型的 86% 降至 GPT-3 175B 的 52% [S3.T11]。

evidence.quote: GPT-3 achieves strong performance on many NLP datasets, including translation, question-answering, and cloze tasks
in a zero-shot setting GPT-3 achieves 76% on LAMBADA, a gain of 8% over the previous state of the art
GPT-3 achieves 86.4% accuracy in the few-shot setting, an increase of over 18% from the previous state-of-the-art
On TriviaQA, we achieve 64.3% in the zero-shot setting, 68.0% in the one-shot setting, and 71.2% in the few-shot setting.
The zero-shot result already outperforms the fine-tuned T5-11B by 14.2%
GPT-3 175B achieves 85 F1 in the few-shot setting, only a few points behind measured human performance and state-of-the-art fine-tuned models.

we also find some tasks on which few-shot performance struggles, even at the scale of GPT-3. This includes natural language inference tasks like the ANLI dataset, and some reading comprehension datasets like RACE or QuAC.
human accuracy ... ranges from 86% on the control model to 52% on GPT-3 175B

limitations.text: 作者承认 GPT-3 存在若干结构性局限：实验仅使用自回归语言模型，未包含双向架构或其他训练目标，这可能解释其在 WiC、ANLI 和部分阅读理解任务上的落后表现 [S5.p3]。作者还指出，扩大任何类 LM 模型最终可能触及预训练目标的极限，因为当前目标对每个 token 等权加权，且缺乏对预测重要性的区分 [S5.p4]。另一个局限是预训练样本效率差，GPT-3 在预训练中看到的文本仍远多于人类一生所见 [S5.p5]。此外，作者承认不确定少样本学习究竟是在推理时从零学习新任务，还是仅识别训练中已学到的任务 [S5.p6]。模型规模巨大导致推理昂贵且不便，可能影响实际应用 [S5.p7]。在数据污染方面，作者承认由于过滤 bug 未能完全移除重叠，且无法确定干净子集与原数据集同分布 [S2.SS2.p4][S4.p10]。

evidence.quote: our experiments do not include any bidirectional architectures or other training objectives such as denoising
This could be a possible explanation for GPT-3’s lagging few-shot performance on a few of the tasks, such as WIC ... ANLI ... and several reading comprehension tasks
scaling pure self-supervised prediction is likely to hit limits, and augmentation with a different approach is likely to be necessary
it still sees much more text during pre-training than a human sees in the their lifetime
ambiguity about whether few-shot learning actually learns new tasks “from scratch” at inference time, or if it simply recognizes and identifies tasks that it has learned during training
they are both expensive and inconvenient to perform inference on, which may present a challenge for practical applicability
a bug in the filtering caused us to ignore some overlaps, and due to the cost of training it was not feasible to retrain the model
we cannot be sure that the clean subset is drawn from the same distribution as the original dataset
